If you're new to the NYT Connections puzzle here's how to play. On your grid, you'll start with sixteen words that you have to place into four groups. To submit a category guess you have to look for four words with a common thread. Once you've selected your words, you need to click/tap to select each word and press submit. If your guess is correct, it will change color; Connections has four difficulty levels. Each group is given a color which will reveal as you solve. YellowStraightforward and easy. GreenPotentially unfamiliar terms or trivia. BluePotentially unfamiliar terms or trivia. PurpleTrickiest category to guess. NYT Connection FAQs Got a question about the daily Connections word game? See if we've answered it here. What time does the NYT Connections puzzle come out? The NYT Connections daily puzzle is refreshed at midnight local time. Who edits the NYT Connections game? The current version of NYT Connections is edited by crossword constructor Wyna Liu who has been editing puzzles at The Times since 2020. Find today's Connections answer here. Where can I play the NYT Connections? You can play NYT Connections online and on mobile with the New York Times Game App. More NYT Games Tools
